purpose: Define each machine-significant field/property as an explicit semantic identity with owning schema/type, value type, optionality and constraints.

topics.name: Field Identity
topics.purpose: Define each machine-significant field/property as an explicit semantic identity with owning schema/type, value type, optionality and constraints.

semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable machine-significant field has explicit identity.
semantics.owner_rule: Owning record/schema/domain semantic owner is explicit.
semantics.name_rule: Serialized field name/label is separate from field semantic identity.
semantics.classification_rule: Governance/classification metadata may bind exact field identity.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Renaming serialized key need not change semantic field identity if mapping is explicit.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: field semantics inferred only from JSON key
renaming key creates new field automatically
